instructions: Footprint summary slots. Owner-facing voice only.

rows.body: Choice-affiliated Radisson Blu in the Americas includes U.S. and Canada gateways plus open hotels in the Caribbean and Latin America (Aruba, Argentina, Brazil, Chile). Confirm current hotel counts and pipeline in your franchise disclosure.

Upper-upscale growth in CALA emphasizes resort and urban destinations—Bariloche, Belo Horizonte Savassi, São Paulo, Santiago, and Aruba. Global Blu scale (much of it outside the Americas) supports guest recognition; your project should budget for design-forward public spaces, meetings where relevant, and Choice Privileges participation.
